This repository (**MapMetSC**) provides the `R`-based single-cell analysis
workflow used in Lazic et al., in which primary and metastatic neuroblastoma are
spatially and temporally mapped by multi-modal high-plex imaging in combination
with scRNA-seq datasets. It is the downstream counterpart of the `python`-based
image-processing pipeline [MapMetIP](https://github.com/TaschnerMandlGroup/MapMetIP).

See the [Home](index.html) page for the ordered list of analysis steps, and the
repository `README` and `run_analysis.R` for setup and reproduction instructions.
